D2 fast-fail debugger-watchdog diagnostic trigger

Base:
811afc84ac0bc00285b24ef786c8ad92b074009d

Same-artifact physical sampling completed:
- Run1: V74 once, no breakpoint/debugreg markers, natural 0xC0000409
- Run2: no breakpoint/debugreg markers, no V74, reached display + fallback stack sync, natural 0xC0000409
- no ForceStop in either run
- therefore hardware-breakpoint capture path was not exercised in either sample
- do not take a third 811afc84 sample

Purpose:
- leave all NCE/runtime code frozen at 811afc84
- extend only the existing out-of-process V63 watchdog into a Windows debugger observer
- capture STATUS_FAIL_FAST_EXCEPTION / 0xC0000409 before termination:
  - first/second chance
  - ExceptionAddress / flags / NumberParameters / ExceptionInformation[0..3]
  - stopped-thread PC/SP/LR/X18
  - remote TEB StackBase / StackLimit via X18
  - instruction word at PC
- first debugger-attach breakpoint only is consumed
- all later process exceptions are continued as DBG_EXCEPTION_NOT_HANDLED so the existing NCE VEH receives them normally

No production semantic change.
